summary: The notebook currently holds two notes: a foundations course note on gradient descent and a structured reading of the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: A single course note covers gradient descent basics: the update rule, a worked quadratic example, and learning-rate pitfalls.
areas.gap: No notes yet on momentum, Adam, second-order methods, or regularization beyond the baseline descent loop.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: One reading note walks through the Transformer architecture: self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encodings, and WMT 2014 results.
areas.gap: No notes on later Transformer variants, training-stability recipes, or sub-quadratic attention methods despite these being flagged as follow-ups.
